name: Saints of the Fallen Cross
detailed_description:
Prepare to embark on an intense, top-down journey through a post-apocalyptic landscape overrun by the undead. Saints of the Fallen Cross blends deep survival mechanics with fast-paced action, delivering a truly immersive experience for solo players and co-op enthusiasts alike. Scavenge vital resources, build fortified havens, master powerful skills, and unite with (or battle against) others to endure the ever-growing threat of the zombie hordes.

Comprehensive Multiplayer Support

Team up—or go it alone—across LAN, P2P, Steam, or dedicated servers.

Seamlessly save and continue progress with friends, ensuring cooperative or competitive play stays fluid and uninterrupted.

Advanced Inventory, Crafting & Customization

Manage gear with an intuitive jigsaw-style inventory system and integrated backpack mechanics.

Craft a wide range of tools, weapons, and supplies while keeping an eye on realistic weight constraints.

Tailor your survivor’s appearance and loadout, ensuring you’re always ready for the next challenge.

Versatile Combat Systems

Switch effortlessly between brutal melee and precise ranged combat:

Melee: Wield one-handed and two-handed tools like axes, pickaxes, and shovels—each with its own feel.

Ranged: Arm yourself with pistols, shotguns, assault rifles, and more, each featuring distinct animations and handling.

Tactics: Spice up encounters by using grenades, placing traps, or luring enemies into hazards.

Deep Progression & Skill Systems

Level up and customize your character through an expansive skill tree.

Unlock powerful abilities that suit your playstyle—stealthy scavenger, fearless bruiser, or cunning strategist.

Robust Quest, Dialogue & Journal Framework

Immerse yourself in a narrative-rich experience, with dynamic quests and meaningful dialogues.

Keep track of your journey in a comprehensive journal, shaping your path through the apocalypse.

Modular Building Tools

Construct your own safehouses or entire settlements:

Place foundations, walls, and interactive objects (campfires, furnaces, workbenches) with ease.

Repair or destroy structures thanks to a durability system that keeps the world ever-evolving.

Mold environments around your strategies—whether you want a sprawling fortress or a hidden retreat.

Realistic Interaction & Resource Systems

Lockpicking: Break into locked areas with an authentic audio-visual system.

Gardening & Farming: Cultivate crops across multiple growth stages, leveraging hoes and watering cans to stay self-sufficient.

Resource Harvesting: Chop trees, mine ore, and dig for hidden items, fueling your survival efforts.

Enhanced Audio-Visual Feedback

Feel every step with advanced footstep effects for walking, running, jumping, and landing.

Immerse yourself in atmospheric soundscapes and tense music, complemented by character vocalizations.

Navigate confidently with integrated HUD, mini and global maps, and a specialized top-down camera system.

Specialized AI & NPC Systems

Confront dynamic zombie hordes featuring adaptive behaviors and efficient spawners.

Tackle a range of NPC survivors with varying agendas, forging alliances or rivalries in your fight to survive.

Dynamic Gameplay Systems

Maintain vital survival stats (health, hunger, thirst, energy) in a harsh world that never stops testing you.

Loot in a constantly shifting environment, thanks to a dynamic spawning system.

Survive lethal hazards like gas zones and environmental traps, bolstered by a robust damage model and ragdoll physics.

Enjoy smooth movement with precise IK foot placement, ensuring every action feels grounded and responsive.

Are you ready to survive the apocalypse from a thrilling new perspective? Secure your base, gear up, and dive into the relentless world of Saints of the Fallen Cross. The undead await—how long will you last?

short_description: Blast through an intense top-down zombie survival experience. Scavenge, craft, build, and fight endless hordes of the undead. With heroism, deep progression, and dynamic combat, carve your story in a brutal post-apocalypse. Forge alliances or stand alone—how long can you outlast the rising terror?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 2.77GHz Quad-core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 2 GB of RAM minimum, OpenGL 2.1 and GLSL 1.2 support (generally 2012 or newer)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
